continuation.technical_failure: stop; no silent retry or reroute

weight_snapshots.size_excludes: serialization headers, metadata and already archived parents
reconstruction: apply all five BASE checkpoint weights
overwrite selected-layer weight with saved tensor
weight_snapshots.required_parents: retain original model payload and all three BASE checkpoint payloads
metadata: parent model revision and checkpoint SHA
last case ID and ordered applied edit IDs
weight_snapshots.save_protocol: independent CPU tensor copy; temporary file then atomic rename
validation: reload and check tensor bitwise equality
all nonselected weights unchanged from parent; otherwise stop
weight_snapshots.scope_limit: unsaved intermediate models require replay; exact editor resume also requires history/RNG
